bridgeRouteRisk.summary: spUSDT has two canonical local Spark ERC-4626 issuance routes, on Ethereum and Arbitrum, and no bridge control mints spUSDT representations. The Arbitrum vault's Spark Receiver-to-Executor path is cross-chain governance transport for that local native vault, not a spUSDT bridge. Its collateral is USDT0, whose Ethereum lock-and-mint adapter and Arbitrum OFT/token are a separate LayerZero bridge representation of Tether's Ethereum USDT; the USDT0 owner Safe is therefore a collateral-bridge failure domain rather than a spUSDT issuer or minter. LayerZero DVN configuration and rate limits were not independently enumerated, so the collateral dependency remains external-lock-mint and no narrower tier is claimed.
bridgeRouteRisk.reviewer: Pharos mint/bridge boundary migration; verified susdt-spark research finding
